Early autumn, thoughtful and bright
The night crew are ready
Ready for a calm season in the cabin

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping the focus on steady handling, clear checks, and quiet reassurance for every journey. Staff should continue to guide travelers through the usual steps, confirm carrier comfort, and stay alert for signs of stress so animals can settle well before departure. <<FACT F012>> With that foundation in place, crews can support smoother handovers and keep the experience predictable for travelers and pets alike.

Aurelia Skyways also reminds staff to keep instructions plain and friendly, since a calm tone helps the whole cabin feel more settled. Small details matter, from secure placement to attentive monitoring, and the team is ready to help travelers feel prepared. Companion Animal Travel Desk
